info.title: ServiceGrid IQ implemented Phase 4 scheduling foundation
info.description: Local-only technician, branch, owner-verified qualification and interval availability management. Job and technician mutations require current versions. Appointment start must be inside the arrival window. One shift covers travel plus work; all intervals are half-open. Eligibility is a snapshot, with no ranking, parts readiness or public booking endpoint. AWS and production deployment remain deferred.
